requirement:
The view of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes` MUST use
the current workspace source at book-render time and explicitly identify its
contents as current workspace source notes. This MUST also hold when the link
originates in a historical test report.
rationale: The requirement `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes.current` has three obligations. The notes view must use the current workspace source at book-render time. It must explicitly identify its contents as current workspace source notes. Both must also hold when the link comes from a historical test report. The marked tests cover all three. **Current source at render time** - `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[combined_and_historical_file_links_share_current_source_notes_without_collecting]` records a run, then writes `code.rs` with a new explanation after capture. It calls `populate` and asserts that the generated notes chapter contains "Current explanation, added after capture." This would fail if the view used captured or stale source. - `src/execution_coverage/notes.rs#mod[tests]/fn[each_render_reads_current_notes_and_validates_saved_reviews_without_writing]` renders, edits the source, and renders again. It asserts that the updated text appears and that the original explanation no longer appears before the "Review:" marker. It also asserts that the saved review status is recomputed and the saved review file is unchanged. **Explicit identification** - Both tests assert that the page contains "Current workspace source notes". - The book test also asserts the page contains the workspace-relative path, using the `File: {file}` form. - The `notes.rs` implementation in `fn[pages]` emits this label and a statement that the page is not the captured source. I read it only to confirm the label text. The expected behaviour comes from the requirement. **Historical-report origin** - In the book test, the historical per-test chapter (the one starting with "# Test process coverage") is found. For `code.rs`, `src/a.rs` and `src/nested/a.rs`, the test checks that its file card has an href to the shared notes page. - The test asserts that exactly one notes chapter exists for the path, so the historical and combined links lead to the same current-source page. - The combined index link to the notes page is asserted in `file_maps_union_process_locations_and_filter_unexecuted_test_files`. That test has no `{test}` reference to this requirement, but the main test exercises the combined index's notes pages, so I don't count this as a gap. No assertion is missing for any obligation the text states. I found no gap and no {fixme} acknowledgments.
